question: Estimate the campaign reach of a cinema ad (in-theatre slide + video) running in 800 multiplex screens for 2 weeks.
idealClarificationQuestions: Cinema ad = pre-feature 30-second video shown to all moviegoers? Yes.
800 screens across PVR, INOX, Cinepolis = ~30% of multiplex screens? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Footfall per screen × screens × campaign duration.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average occupancy per screen show: ~50% × 200 seats = 100 people.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Footfall per screen per day: ~450 people.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But repeat moviegoers (people watching multiple movies in 2 weeks): ~20% = 10 lakh duplicates.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~40 lakh unique Indians reached via 2-week cinema campaign.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: But repeat moviegoers (people watching multiple movies in 2 weeks)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~40 lakh unique Indians reached via 2-week cinema campaign.

calculationFlow: Average occupancy per screen show: ~50% × 200 seats = 100 people.
Total daily footfall across 800 screens: 800 × 450 = 3.6 lakh people/day.
But repeat moviegoers (people watching multiple movies in 2 weeks): ~20% = 10 lakh duplicates.
Round: ~40 lakh unique Indians reached via 2-week cinema campaign.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~40 lakh unique Indians reached via 2-week cinema campaign.
